pre = acct_df[acct_df['date'] < date]

print("Verify price*num_instances == unblended_cost:",
      (abs(acct_df['price']*acct_df['num_instances'] - acct_df['unblended_cost']) < 1e-6).all())

for col in ['csp', 'cloud_service', 'application', 'instance_family']:
    pre_sum = pre.groupby(col)['unblended_cost'].sum().rename('pre_total')
    post_sum = post.groupby(col)['unblended_cost'].sum().rename('post_total')
    pre_days = pre['date'].nunique()
    post_days = post['date'].nunique()
    cmp = pd.concat([pre_sum, post_sum], axis=1).fillna(0)
    cmp['pre_daily_avg'] = cmp['pre_total'] / pre_days
    cmp['post_daily_avg'] = cmp['post_total'] / post_days
    cmp['delta'] = cmp['post_daily_avg'] - cmp['pre_daily_avg']
    cmp = cmp.sort_values('delta', ascending=False, key=abs)
    print(f"\n=== {col} (top 10 by |delta daily avg|) ===")
    print(cmp.head(10).to_string())
